# kicad-splitplane

> Splits one copper layer of a KiCad board (.kicad_pcb) into exactly one continuous zone per supply net (e.g. +5V, +3V3, +1V8 on an inner power layer), computed from the nets' vias and through-hole pads, and writes the zones into a copy of the board. Command line tool, Python library, KiCad 9+ plugin and MCP server. No KiCad installation needed (except for the plugin). MIT license.

Use it when several supply nets share one plane layer. Never for GND (GND gets its own solid plane) or signal nets. The input board is never overwritten; the output is `<board>_splitplane.kicad_pcb` plus a preview PNG. Afterwards the user fills the zones in KiCad (B) and runs DRC.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/atuzlak/kicad-splitplane/blob/main/README.md): install, options, how it works
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/atuzlak/kicad-splitplane/blob/main/skills/kicad-splitplane/SKILL.md): the full workflow for agents and what to do about each warning
- [Documentation page](https://people.ee.ethz.ch/~atuzlak/kicad-splitplane.html): screenshots, plugin dialog, warnings explained

## Use

- MCP server (stdio): `uvx kicad-splitplane-mcp`, tools `list_power_nets(board_path, all_nets=False)` and `split_plane(board_path, nets, layer="In2.Cu", gap=0.5, edge=0.5, min_neck=1.0, res=0.5, include_smd=False, plain=False, keep_old=False, out_path=None, use_rules=False, keepouts=False, report=False)`. MCP Registry name: io.github.atuzlak/kicad-splitplane
- Command line: `pip install kicad-splitplane`, then `kicad-splitplane board.kicad_pcb --list-nets --json` and `kicad-splitplane board.kicad_pcb --layer In2.Cu --nets +5V +3V3 --json`. Exit code 0 = clean, 1 = warnings or error, 2 = bad arguments. Opt-in: `--rules` (gap and edge from the design rules in <board>.kicad_pro), `--keepouts` (leave keepout areas free), `--report` (HTML report)
- Python: `import kicad_splitplane as sp; r = sp.process(text, "In2.Cu", ["+5V", "+3V3"]); sp.summary(r)`

## Result

`ok` (true = one connected zone per net), `layer`, `nets`, `zones` {net: {parts, area_mm2, seeds}}, `warnings` (trapped vias with a suggested new position, islands, thin necks, unconnected pads), `log`, `files` {board, preview, project, report}; with use_rules also `gap`/`edge`, with keepouts `keepouts` (count). Errors: `{"ok": false, "error": "..."}`.
